name: Curse
source:
Among dust and cobwebs, Natalie finds more than she bargained for – a charm that twists her wishes into nightmares.

[From [url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/curse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在塵土和蛛網間，娜塔莉找到了意料之外的東西：一枚會把她的願望扭曲成惡夢的護身符。

［摘自[url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/curse]Itch.io[/url]］
